SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK FP-01: FHIRPath — §4.1 Literals. Test these items: Boolean literals, String literals, Integer literals, Decimal literals, Date literals, Time literals, DateTime literals, Quantity literals (incl. time-valued quantities). For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.evidence: Fresh EXPLORER probe `.temp/qa/fp01_explorer_literal_probe.py` found native and forced Python fallback accepted year-zero literals such as `@0000-01-01` and returned `0000-01-01`; the spec range begins at @0001-01-01.
issues.root_cause: Python and native temporal literal validators accepted four-digit year 0000 because they checked digit shape and component ranges but not the lower year bound.
issues.resolution: Added year 1..9999 checks in Python FP_Date/FP_DateTime and native parseDateTimeParts; invalid temporal literal evaluation now raises a spec error so fhirpath_is_valid is false and public UDFs return empty/NULL.
issues.verified_in: Probe 23/23 clean; literal parity 17 passed; equality/arithmetic/regression slice 49 passed; native unittest 326 assertions; full conformance 2822/2822.

issues.evidence: Fresh EXPLORER probe found `10'\u006Dg'` returned `10 '\u006Dg'` in forced Python fallback but `10 'mg'` in native C++; Quantity units are single-quoted strings, so string escape semantics apply.
issues.root_cause: Python quantity_literal read quoted unit token text directly instead of applying the canonical FHIRPath string unescape pass.
issues.resolution: Unescaped quoted Quantity unit token contents before constructing FP_Quantity, preserving quotes around the normalized unit.
issues.verified_in: Probe 23/23 clean; literal parity 17 passed; full conformance 2822/2822.

issues.evidence: Fresh EXPLORER probe found both backends accepted `1 ''` as a Quantity with empty unit. The spec requires a specified unit string that is a valid UCUM unit or calendar duration keyword.
issues.root_cause: Both Python and native Quantity literal paths allowed an empty string token as the unit.
issues.resolution: Rejected empty quoted Quantity unit literals in Python quantity_literal and native QuantityLiteral evaluation.
issues.verified_in: Probe 23/23 clean; literal parity 17 passed; native unittest 326 assertions; full conformance 2822/2822.

issues.evidence: Fresh EXPLORER probe found forced Python fallback marked `(true | false | 'x' | 1 | 1.0 | @2014 | @T14 | @2014T | 1 'mg').select($this.toString()).count()` invalid and returned empty, while native C++ returned 8. FHIRPath expressions may chain literals, operators, and invocations.
issues.root_cause: Python equality tried to parse non-string, non-temporal values as temporal values whenever either operand was temporal during union de-duplication.
issues.resolution: Added type guards so temporal equality against non-string/non-temporal peers returns empty instead of raising, allowing mixed literal chains to continue.
issues.verified_in: Probe 23/23 clean; mixed literal parity regression passed in literal parity suite; equality/arithmetic/regression slice 49 passed; full conformance 2822/2822.
